### [LifeVal](https://openai.com/index/lifeval)

**OpenAI** · 2026-11-02

OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a new benchmark designed to measure how effectively AI models assist humans with everyday real-world tasks.

- Evaluates AI performance across practical daily responsibilities including finding childcare, managing personal finances, and completing government paperwork.
- Focuses on measuring practical human utility and task completion rather than traditional synthetic NLP metrics.

**Why it matters:** It establishes a standardized framework for evaluating how effectively AI systems execute complex, real-world administrative and personal tasks.

### [llm 0.37](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/2/llm/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-11-02

Version 0.37 of the LLM CLI and Python library adds new OpenAI models, a command for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, multimodal embedding content-type support, and updates the fallback default model.

- Added support for models gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra.
- Introduced the 'llm openai endpoint add' command to simplify configuring OpenAI-compatible API endpoints.
- Updated the default fallback model to gpt-6-luna, reducing cost by 50% compared to the previous gpt-5.6-luna default.
- Enhanced embedding support to handle varying content-types for binary input, enabling integration with multimodal models like Gemini Embedding 2.

**Why it matters:** The updates simplify custom API endpoint setup and expand embedding capabilities to handle multimodal inputs like audio, images, and video alongside text.

`llm` `cli` `python` `openai` `embeddings`

### [datasette-llm 0.1a9](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/31/datasette-llm/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-10-31

Datasette-llm 0.1a9 now automatically inherits the default model configured in the LLM tool, removing the need for manual model flags.

- Datasette-llm 0.1a9 automatically detects and uses the default model set by LLM.
- Eliminates the requirement to manually pass '-s plugins.datasette-agent.default_model <model>' during startup.
- Simplifies launching Datasette Agent via commands like 'uvx --with datasette-agent datasette content.db --internal internal.db'.

**Why it matters:** Users can run Datasette Agent with fewer command-line arguments and configuration steps by relying on their global LLM default model.

`datasette` `datasette-agent` `datasette-llm` `llm` `python`
